summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing preliminary 2026 gross revenue guidance above $5,000,000, versus approximately $1,341,000 in 2025 — implied growth of at least 272%. No transaction, stakeholder action, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings/guidance disclosure, incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registrations. Forecasts are unaudited and management-prepared. What to watch: order backlog conversion and whether 2026 guidance is subsequently revised.
